evidence.quote: enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The assertion enacts a governance rule — saving a memory assigns the relational role of reviewer to the creator — an authority-ranking allocation of a position.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The segment frames itself as a vehicle for the enrollment rule, reinforcing the authority-ranking act by subordinating its own purpose to carrying that governance assertion.
